# Common Music Notation staff projection profile

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:profileCMNStaff`](gmeow-profileCMNStaff.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/profileCMNStaff>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Projection profile for Western staff notation: represents 12-EDO pitch, rational metric time, order, tempo, dynamics, instrumentation, and performer count; loses microtiming, timbre, non-12-EDO tuning frames, traversal constraints, spectral derivation, continuous trajectories, spatial/sound context.
